newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-SALOMON REPEATS TRAKYA BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SALOMON REPEATS TRAKYA BUY.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Monday it had reiterated its strong buy recommendation on Turkish flat glass maker Trakya Cam Sanayii A.S. following first half results released last week.
The U.S. investment house said it had a year-end target for the share price of 13,500 lira, up from 8,100 at present.

Bull factors included strong Turkish demand for flat glass and the closure of the Cayirova sheet glass plant --- the only other flat glass producer -- by the end of 1997. Cayirova is a unit of Turkiye Sise ve Cam Fabrikalari A.S..
